description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_URIDefinition, which extends HTMLPurifier_Definition. It manages URI definitions, including filter registration, setup, and application, within the HTML Purifier library.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_URIDefinition
classes.description: A class that manages URI definitions, filters, and setup routines within the HTMLPurifier library.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that registers default filters for URI processing.

methods.name: registerFilter
methods.description: Registers a filter object into the registeredFilters array.

methods.name: addFilter
methods.description: Adds a filter to either filters or postFilters depending on its 'post' property, after preparing it with the given configuration.

methods.name: doSetup
methods.description: Performs setup by initializing member variables and filters based on configuration.

methods.name: setupFilters
methods.description: Iterates over registered filters and adds them if they are marked to always load or if configuration permits.

methods.name: setupMemberVariables
methods.description: Initializes the host, base URI, and default scheme from configuration, parsing the base URI if provided.

methods.name: getDefaultScheme
methods.description: Returns the default URI scheme from the scheme registry based on the stored defaultScheme.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Applies all filters in the filters array to the given URI; returns false if any filter fails.

methods.name: postFilter
methods.description: Applies all postFilters to the URI after initial filtering; returns false if any filter fails.
